findings.evidence: Lines 106–110 assume only `TopologicalSpace`; lines 206–211 quantify arbitrary `S : Set F`. The module notes at lines 83–88 explicitly confirm that `F = M`, `S = range f`, and `OpenPartialHomeomorph.refl M` flatten every embedding, whereas roadmap lines 294–305 require manifold embeddings locally modeled on `ℝⁿ ⊆ ℝᵐ`.
findings.fix: Define the public local-flatness predicate for manifold/model-space data with a constrained standard coordinate slice (including boundary models); keep any arbitrary-pair chart relation only as an internal transport abstraction.
findings.issue: `IsLocallyFlat S f` permits arbitrary topological spaces and arbitrary `S`; choosing `F = M`, `S = range f`, and the identity chart makes every embedding locally flat, so the declaration does not capture the roadmap’s coordinate-slice condition.

summary: The central predicate formalizes flatness relative to an arbitrary caller-chosen subset, not local flatness of manifold embeddings into a coordinate slice.
